description: Curated known-bloatware whitelist for the OemBloatware detector (chunk P2-C1). A match here is the ONLY thing this project ever labels 'Safe to remove'. Matching rules and the review status of this list are documented in Data/README.md.

entries.reason: Third-party freemium spreadsheet viewer delivered as a preinstalled Store app. It opens .xlsx files read-only and upsells a paid FileViewer Pro licence; Windows and any real spreadsheet application already cover the same file types.
Preinstalled launcher/advertising stub for a Microsoft 365 subscription. It is not Office itself and installs nothing; removing it does not affect an installed Office or Microsoft 365 desktop suite.

Preinstalled standalone Copilot assistant app. It is a normal removable app rather than a shell component, ships on consumer Windows 11 images without being asked for, and leaves no dependent OS feature behind when uninstalled.
entries.note: Ships twice on this machine: as an Appx package AND as a system-level Win32 install under the Program Files (x86) Microsoft Copilot folder. Both match rules below are deliberate - the two installs need two different removal calls.

entries.reason: Preinstalled developer dashboard that Microsoft stopped developing and removed from new Windows images in 2025. Nothing in the OS depends on it and it is not installed on request.

entries.displayName: King promotional games (Candy Crush and friends)
entries.reason: Promotional games pushed onto consumer Windows installs by the Windows content-delivery mechanism rather than chosen by the user. No OS feature depends on them.
Advertising app on Dell factory images whose only function is to present partner offers and trial software.
Survey and marketing-prompt app on Dell factory images. It performs no maintenance, driver or support function.
First-run onboarding and offer-promotion app on HP factory images. It is not the HP support, diagnostics or driver-update utility.
Preinstalled trial-game storefront bundled onto OEM factory images. It exists to sell game sessions and installs its own background updater.
